title: No God or Son has come down — opening charge (chs. 1–16)
english: Book V opens without forbidden wordiness: Celsus tells Jews and Christians that no God or God’s Son has come down or will; Origen undertakes to overturn that sentence.
translator_notes: Copy-text Koetschau GCS 2–3 Perseus TEI; no Chadwick/ANF Crombie.
True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B; condensed book CLOSEOUT.
Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: Cycles, stars, and a perishable world (chs. 17–32)
english: Pythagoreans and Platonists who keep the world imperishable still fall into star-cycles; Scripture’s creation and end are not the same story.

title: Sabbath years and servant release (chs. 33–48)

title: World crucified to me — BOOK V CLOSEOUT (chs. 49–65)
